evidence.title: A Map Component for shadcn/ui - shadcn map

name: shadcn map
summary: A map component for shadcn/ui built on Leaflet and React Leaflet, with 32 usage examples.
description: An interactive map component styled after shadcn/ui. It uses Leaflet with React Leaflet for the map and MapLibre GL to render OpenFreeMap vector tiles, so no API key is needed; the docs cover 32 examples including custom tiles, markers, clusters, shapes, popups and zoom, fullscreen, layers, locate, search and draw controls.
contains: map component following shadcn/ui design patterns
Leaflet + React Leaflet with MapLibre GL vector tiles
examples: custom tiles, markers, clusters, shapes, popup, zoom, fullscreen, layers, locate, search and draw controls
